messages:
elaine: Heads-up — PR #4321 needs a final pass for the ErrRef updates (429s, timeouts, context limits). Mostly link swaps, a couple SDK snippet replacements, and one new example for graceful fallback. Can reviewers check before EOD?

sam: On it. I can audit the examples and runtime snippets. Which SDK snippet are we replacing?

elaine: Replace the old per-client retry example with the new unified-retries pattern we landed last sprint. Also add a short context-trim example showing how to detect and trim to avoid 413/429 cascades. I threw a short draft gist here: https://gist.github.com/redwood/tmp-errref-examples

docs-bot: Reminder: please include checklist items from docs PR template (preview link, changelog entry, translation flag) :memo:

mike: I can take link fixes and verify redirects. There are a couple of legacy anchors that 404 in the current sidebar. Will patch anchors and update crossrefs.

jess: FYI the staging docs preview failed for this branch — pipeline shows a 422 from the static site generator when building /errref/429.md. Error log snippet below:

```
Error: Failed to render page: /errref/429.md
  at build: html generation failed
  details: frontmatter parsing error: unknown field "old_sample_ref"
Exit code: 1
```

sam: I can repro locally. Looks like one of the migrated files still has the deprecated frontmatter flag. I'll open a tiny PR to remove it and re-run the preview.

elaine: Thanks. When you open the PR, please keep both ruby and python snippets intact — just swap the retry pattern. Also add a single-line note recommending an exponential backoff (and an example window) for 429s.

mike: Pushed a commit that updates anchors and cleans a few broken internal links. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-4321--docs.redwood.ai. Pinging reviewers.

sam: Opened PR #4322 to strip the old frontmatter and fix the preview build, plus updated the unified-retries snippet. Diff is tiny.

elaine: Merge gates: need two approvals from docs team and one from eng-sre for the fallback example semantics. @sam @jess can you review?

sam: Reviewing now — will approve if preview looks clean. :white_check_mark:

jess: Will take a look after lunch, but low risk from my side.

elaine: Great — plan to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT if there are no blockers. Thanks all!
